headline: Microsoft dismantled the GigaWiper destructive backdoor while warning that AI is collapsing the time defenders have to patch a freshly disclosed flaw.

emerging_trends.text: Defenders are racing a clock that artificial intelligence keeps shortening, and Microsoft is rewriting its Windows patch guidance because AI now narrows the gap between a fix and a working exploit to minutes.
Attackers keep burrowing into developer infrastructure, spinning up 200 GitHub repositories and years-old dormant ghost accounts while poisoning npm to reach corporate networks.
Voice phishing has become the extortionist's favorite key, and the new Helix crew is calling employees to pry open SharePoint troves through device-code tricks and MFA abuse.

topics.title: Malware Floods GitHub and npm
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek exposed a network of 200 GitHub repositories that use a Go module to load PowerShell and fetch Windows malware from public dead drops, as Datadog warned of campaigns riding years-old dormant ghost accounts to map corporate orgs, SecurityWeek detailed HalluSquatting weaponizing AI package-name hallucinations for remote code execution, and GitHub shipped npm 12 with install scripts disabled by default.
topics.summary: Attackers increasingly hide inside developer platforms, from GitHub repositories and OAuth tokens to poisoned package names. Defenders should audit dependencies, keep auto-run install scripts off, and monitor GitHub access.

sources.title: Network of 200 GitHub Repositories Used for Malware Infection
Dormant GitHub Accounts Help Attackers Blend In While Mapping Corporate Orgs
'HalluSquatting' Turns AI Hallucinations Into Botnet Delivery Mechanism
npm 12 Disables Install Scripts by Default to Reduce Supply Chain Risk

topics.title: GigaWiper Destructive Backdoor
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft's threat team dissected GigaWiper on July 9, a Windows backdoor that welds three older destructive programs into one menu-driven platform—a standalone disk wiper, a multi-pass command that overwrites the Windows drive, and fake ransomware that scrambles files with a key it never saves.
topics.summary: GigaWiper hands an operator a choice of ways to destroy a machine, and its sham encryption leaves no path to recovery. Microsoft published detection and defense guidance for the assembled malware.

sources.title: GigaWiper: Anatomy of a destructive backdoor assembled from multiple malware
New GigaWiper Windows Backdoor Bundles Disk Wiping, Fake Ransomware, and Spyware
GigaWiper Combines Multiple Malware for System-Level Sabotage

topics.title: AI Compresses the Patch Window
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft urged organizations on July 10 to shorten Windows update deployment timelines, warning that AI shrinks the span between a patch's release and a working exploit, and said AI-discovered flaws in its own code will push its monthly update counts higher.
topics.summary: Microsoft is reworking its patch-cadence advice as AI speeds both vulnerability discovery and exploitation. Help Net Security's July forecast notes June already brought over 200 Microsoft CVEs, straining the practicality of CVE tracking.

sources.title: Microsoft is rewriting Windows patch guidance because of AI
Microsoft expects more Windows security updates from AI-discovered flaws
July 2026 Patch Tuesday forecast: Is CVE tracking still practical?

topics.title: BlackCat Negotiator Sentenced
topics.latest_developments: A U.S. court sentenced Martino, a former DigitalMint incident-response employee, to 70 months in prison for conspiring with the defunct BlackCat/ALPHV crew and two other security professionals to extort U.S. companies in 2023.
topics.summary: The case exposes insider betrayal within incident-response ranks: a negotiator paid to fight ransomware instead helped run BlackCat extortion against the victims he was hired to defend.

sources.title: Former ransomware negotiator gets 4 years for BlackCat attacks
Ransomware Negotiator Gets 70 Months in Prison for Aiding BlackCat Attacks

topics.title: Helix Vishing Extortion Crew
topics.latest_developments: BleepingComputer identified Helix on July 9, a new data-extortion group stealing from SharePoint environments through voice phishing, device-code phishing, and multi-factor authentication abuse.
topics.summary: Helix leans on identity tricks rather than malware, calling employees to gain access and exfiltrate SharePoint data. Enforce phishing-resistant MFA and verify anyone claiming to be IT.

sources.title: New Helix vishing group emerges in SharePoint data theft attacks

topics.title: GhostLock Linux Root Flaw
topics.latest_developments: Researchers disclosed GhostLock on July 9, a 15-year-old Linux kernel privilege-escalation flaw present in every major distribution since 2011 that hands attackers root and earned the finders a $92,000 Google bounty.
topics.summary: GhostLock lets a local user escalate to root across Linux desktops, servers, and derived systems. Administrators should apply their distribution's kernel updates.

sources.title: 15-Year-Old Linux Vulnerability 'GhostLock' Earns Researchers $92k From Google

business_politics.latest_developments: SK Hynix raised $26.51 billion selling American depositary receipts and debuts on Nasdaq Friday, the largest U.S. listing ever by a foreign company.
business_politics.summary: The South Korean memory-chip maker, a key supplier of the high-bandwidth memory that feeds AI accelerators, tapped surging investor appetite for AI hardware; the Financial Times called the jumbo sale a sign of overheated markets.

business_politics.title: IEA Warns of Global Fuel Supply Crunch
business_politics.latest_developments: The International Energy Agency warned Friday that refinery outages across the Gulf and Russia threaten a petrol and diesel supply crunch, even as crude futures fell on hopes that U.S.-Iran tensions stay contained.
business_politics.summary: Wars have knocked out refining capacity in the Persian Gulf and in Russia—where Ukrainian drones now reach Siberian energy assets—while global fuel consumption holds high, tightening product markets even as oil prices ease.

business.title: Walmart Seeks Bloomfield Delivery Hub
business.latest_developments: Walmart asked Pittsburgh's zoning board Thursday to convert the vacant Rite Aid on Liberty Avenue in Bloomfield into an online-grocery delivery hub, drawing opposition from neighbors.
business.summary: Shoppers would place orders through Walmart's app for pickup or delivery, and the depot would have no walk-in store; Bloomfield residents testified the plan adds traffic without giving the neighborhood a place to shop.

business.latest_developments: Giant Eagle said it is lowering prices on more than 300 grocery staples for the rest of the summer.
business.summary: The Pittsburgh-based grocer framed the reductions on key items as relief for shoppers facing elevated food costs across its western Pennsylvania stores.

team_usa.summary: Pulisic, the U.S. captain and AC Milan attacker, left the 4-1 round-of-16 defeat in Seattle in the second half; imaging Tuesday confirmed the injury after a home World Cup in which his availability drew criticism.
